english_source_note: Estimates for the Sum of Prime Reciprocals
english_title: Quantitative Version of the Above Problem
statement_en: Assume $p\in \mathbb{P}$. Estimate the function defined by the series $$S(x):=\sum_{p\leq x} \frac{1}{p}.$$
callout_body: 假设$p\in \mathbb{P}$,估计由级数定义出来的函数$$S(x):=\sum_{p\leq x} \frac{1}{p}$$
